name: Sangteisang: XX Hogeun XXX
source:
Summertime is here, and so is the love of your life!

In this otome game, you'll wake up in a certain game and find yourself surrounded by three guys who want you. But there's a catch: you'll die if you don't find true love!

Can you survive this Abnormal State and find your happily ever after? Find out in this exciting summer romance!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=carpe.story.stat&hl=en_US]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
夏天来了，你一生的挚爱也来了！

在这款乙女游戏中，你会在某个游戏中醒来，发现自己被三个想要你的人包围。但有一个问题：如果你找不到真爱，你就会死！

你能在这种异常状态下生存下来并找到幸福吗？在这个激动人心的夏日浪漫中寻找答案吧！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=carpe.story.stat&hl=en_US]Google Play[/url]]
